name: Vermont
standard: WCAG 2.1 AA (State of Vermont Universal Digital Accessibility program; Vermont.gov accessibility policy)

laws.cite: 28 CFR Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web/mobile rule, 2024; compliance dates extended by DOJ IFR effective 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: Requires state and local government web content and mobile apps to conform to WCAG 2.1 AA, with compliance dates now 2027-04-26 (population 50,000+) and 2028-04-26 (smaller entities and special districts).

applies_to: All state agencies and departments with public-facing websites, social media or apps, including third-party-run apps. Local governments via the ADA Title II floor (VLCT guides municipalities).

deadlines.what: ADA Title II floor: state government and local entities with population 50,000+ must conform to WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24 by the 2026 DOJ IFR).
ADA Title II floor: local entities under 50,000 population and special district governments (extended from 2027-04-26).

requires: Step-by-step tasks, including inventorying and improving all digital platforms
Build on the WCAG 2.1 AA State Web Template (Drupal)
Designated accessibility contacts for each template site
mobile: explicit — the program covers mobile apps provided by the State, including those run by third parties.
procurement: No statewide accessibility contract clause found.
enforcement: Reports to SOV.DigitalAccessibility@vermont.gov (also marketing@vermont.gov); program led by the Digital Accessibility Steering Committee; ADA Title II complaints to US DOJ.
notes: No Vermont statute or executive order sets the standard; it is administrative program guidance. The 2017 ADS policy PDF was not opened.
